title: Correct final speed
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer must give the final speed as u = v(sinθ - μ cosθ) or an equivalent expression.

title: Impulse-momentum application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply the impulse-momentum theorem separately to the normal and tangential directions.

title: Normal impulse calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the normal impulse as p_n = m v cosθ from the change in normal momentum.

title: Friction impulse relation
description: Important Criteria: The student must relate the friction impulse to the normal impulse via kinetic friction: p_f = μ p_n.

title: Tangential momentum balance
description: Important Criteria: The solution must set the initial tangential momentum minus the friction impulse equal to the final tangential momentum.

title: Sign error in friction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the friction impulse is incorrectly added to, rather than subtracted from, the initial tangential momentum.

title: Trigonometric component error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if sinθ and cosθ are swapped when resolving the initial velocity components onto the ramp.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The final expression for speed should have correct units (m/s), which can be verified dimensionally.
